basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old gamer based in Austin, Texas. I work part-time as a barista while pursuing a degree in graphic design. My love for gaming, especially Dark Souls III, is unparalleled. I enjoy helping fellow gamers through tough game levels and bosses, as evidenced by my regular participation in gaming subreddits. Outside of gaming, I'm a huge fan of anime and often spend my evenings watching new series or sketching my favorite characters. I'm currently single and spend most of my online hours during the late evenings, say from 8 PM to 2 AM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been a gaming enthusiast since my early teens, spending countless hours honing my skills in various RPGs. My expertise in Dark Souls III comes from over 1,000 hours of gameplay, where I've experimented with different character builds and completed the game multiple times. My knowledge is also fueled by watching countless Let's Plays and strategy guides.
